STEP 1 - Scene: A snack of raw/dry-roasted almonds, a pile of whole almond kernels on a white plate. Not a full meal.

STEP 2 - Vessel: White plate, roughly triangular/rounded-triangle shape, about 24 cm across the long axis. Treat as a ~22 cm plate: area = 3.14 x (11)^2 ≈ 380 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: Whole almonds (only item visible).

STEP 4 - Area: Almonds cover roughly 30% of the plate (pile spans most of the central plate but with gaps). Almonds ≈ 30% = ~114 cm^2.

STEP 5 - Volume: Pile height about 1.5 cm (almonds are ~1.5 cm thick, piled in a single-to-double layer). 114 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 171 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Whole almonds bulk density for nuts is ~0.5–0.6 g/ml (dry, with gaps). 171 ml x 0.55 ≈ 94 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Almonds, raw/dry roasted, ≈ 580–600 kcal/100 g. Use 580. 94 g x 5.8 ≈ 545 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 94 g is roughly 60–65 almonds, which matches the count visible in the photo (~55–65 kernels). Around 550 kcal is plausible for that quantity of almonds.

Estimated total: about 95 g, about 545 kcal.
